positive_snippets:
I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The staff is extremely helpful, polite, and always
willing to assist especially Sonu, Ajay & Zublan. They genuinely understand guest concerns and try their best to resolve them. Breakfast was fresh, tasty, and well managed. Overall, a comfortable and satisfying experience. Would definitely recommend.

This hotel is very great.
- Staff people is too polite and quick.
- Rent is also worth for service.
- Hotel has in-house chef, and provide too good breakfast.
- Rooms feels cozy, when you come after finishing your work.
- Overall, this hotel is best fit, for someone who want a quick business trip and has work near manesar and gurugram area.

I had come here for my business trip and stayed at Saltstayz Hotel. The overall experience was truly excellent. The staff was extremely polite, helpful, and professional — their behavior made the stay very comfortable. The rooms were super clean, well-maintained, and perfectly organized. I had booked a standard room, and it exceeded my expectations in terms of comfort and cleanliness.
The hotel offers great facilities, smooth check-in/check-out, and the atmosphere is peaceful, which is ideal for both business and leisure stays. Honestly, it felt like real value for money. I would highly recommend Saltstayz Hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay.
negative_snippets: They didn't provide room key for 2 days even after repeatedly asking, every time someone used to come to open the room. Breakfast options are ok not that great, when I stayed some company trainees were also there, hence when you come by even 8:30 to 9:00 you get very few food options, please check the room you booked vs offered, 2 days they gave me standard even though I booked premium, after enquiry understood this issue later they changed the room. You need to call multiple times for any service. Not happy about this place.

The receptionist was polite and helpful, but overall the stay was disappointing. The room floor did not feel properly cleaned and it was uncomfortable to walk barefoot. Basic toiletries like shampoo and body lotion were not provided, which is expected from a hotel in this price range.Even after raising complaints about cleanliness and amenities, there was no meaningful response or improvement from the staff. The buffet setup and food presentation were poorly managed, and the South Indian breakfast items like idli were served without proper accompaniments such as chutney and sambar. Because of these issues, this property is not recommended for guests who expect basic hygiene, proper breakfast, and responsive service.
